programme.title: Gershwin's Summertime: The Song That Conquered the World
programme.desc: An investigation into the extraordinary life of Gershwin's classic composition, `Summertime'. One of the most covered songs in the world, it has been recorded in almost every style of music - from jazz to opera, rock to reggae, soul to samba. Its musical adaptability is breathtaking, but `Summertime' also resonates on a deep emotional level too.

programme.title: Genius of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Bettany visits Greece, on the trail of the hugely influential, maverick thinker Socrates, who was executed for his beliefs.

programme.title: The Riviera: A History in Pictures
programme.desc: As transatlantic liners brought America's super-rich to the region, art and celebrity became integrally intertwined as cultural gurus and multi-millionaires all partied on the beach. In an era of sunshine and bathing, of cinema and fast cars, of the Ballet Russes and Monte Carlo casinos, Richard E Grant discovers the extraordinary output of what became briefly the world's creative hub.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Dales
programme.desc: Adventurer and explorer Paul Rose starts his journey in the town of Hawes where locals now run many of their own services, including the buses. Paul checks out why cycling is so popular in the Dales and tries to get to the top of the Buttertubs Pass.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Life on board a narrowboat with Robbie Cumming. Robbie battles his way through blanket weed on the Shropshire Union Canal and accidentally floods a staircase lock in Chester.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.sub-title: The Vanished Capital of the Pharaoh
programme.desc: A journey to discover the legendary lost city of Piramesse, a magnificent ancient capital built 3,000 years ago by the Egyptian pharaoh Ramesses the Great. When it was finally rediscovered by early archaeologists, it opened up a bizarre puzzle because it was in the wrong place.

programme.title: The 1951 Festival of Britain: A Brave New World
programme.desc: Set against the post war period of debt, austerity and rationing, the 1951 Festival of Britain showed how to carve out a bright new future through design and ingenuity, while still having fun. Told by the people who made it happen and making use of some previously unseen colour footage, this is the story of how an extraordinary event changed Britain forever.

programme.title: British Art at War: Bomberg, Sickert and Nash
programme.sub-title: Paul Nash: The Ghosts of War
programme.desc: Andrew Graham Dixon investigates how the ghosts of World War One influenced the work of artist Paul Nash.

programme.title: An Art Lovers' Guide
programme.desc: Although Barcelona is famous for its exuberant modernista buildings, the Gothic Quarter and artistic superstars such as Picasso, Janina and Alastair are determined to discover some less well-known cultural treats.

programme.title: Art That Made Us
programme.desc: A splintering of politics and religion in the British Isles under the Stuart kings leads to more questioning art, new science and architecture.

programme.title: The Yorkshire Dales
programme.desc: Explorer Paul Rose heads for Swaledale, the wildest of the Yorkshire Dales, and joins the farmers who look after rare upland hay meadows. He also visits Muker Show and enters the cake-making contest using a pressure cooker he used on Mount Everest.

programme.title: Canal Boat Diaries
programme.desc: Robbie gets stuck in the mud in Woodseaves Cutting and explores the charming canal-side village of Kinver in Staffordshire.

programme.title: Keeping Up Appearances
programme.desc: Hyacinth takes long-suffering Richard on a weekend break to a golfing hotel, despite the fact that he doesn't like golf, hoping to play a round with the Major.

programme.title: Sorry!
programme.desc: Timothy is suffering from bouts of sleepwalking, which could cause trouble as the annual interview for promotion is just around the corner.

programme.title: A History of Britain by Simon Schama
programme.desc: Simon Schama looks beyond the romantic stories of Cavaliers and Roundheads to the real story of the English Civil War, in which hundreds of thousands died, countless families were torn apart and the nation was divided. Two events unique within British history resulted: the public execution of the monarch, Charles I, and the creation of a republic.

programme.title: Storyville
programme.desc: Telling the untold story of a seemingly ordinary Englishman who spent more than 40 years as a mercenary, fighting other people's wars for money. Dave Tompkins' career as an international mercenary began in Africa and took him all over the world.

programme.title: Timewatch
programme.desc: A look at the construction of the Empire State Building in New York, which was the world's tallest skyscraper when opened in 1931. The programme investigates the building's history through interviews with the people who contributed to the construction of this iconic building.

programme.title: The Jet Stream and Us
programme.desc: A look at how human understanding of the jet stream, a ribbon of fast moving air high in the atmosphere, has grown. It has been responsible for bewildering effects on bomber pilots during WWII, the 1987 hurricane and devastating floods.

programme.title: The Lost Neanderthals
programme.desc: The Mandrin Cave in southern France has been attracting the attention of archaeologists for 30 years. The cave was regularly occupied in prehistoric times, and a remarkable record of human habitation has been preserved by its soils.

programme.title: Inside Chernobyl's Mega Tomb
programme.desc: Documentary which follows the construction of a trailblazing 36,000 tonne steel structure to entomb the ruins of the nuclear power plant destroyed in the 1986 Chernobyl disaster. It films close up with the team of international engineers as they race to build the new structure before Chernobyl's original concrete sarcophaguscollapses.

programme.title: Play for Today
programme.desc: Viewed by society as an embarrassment and an inconvenience, homeless alcoholic Edna is shunted from doss houses to hospitals, psychiatric wards, even prison. When she seems finally to find a stable environment, the house is forced to close.

programme.title: How to Get Ahead
programme.desc: Stephen Smith looks back at the Medieval Age to find out what it took to get ahead at the court of Richard II. Richard presided over the first truly sophisticated and artistic court in England. Painters, sculptors, poets, tailors, weavers and builders flocked to court to make their fortunes. But these were dangerous times. Being close to Richard brought many a courtier to a sticky end. Featuring David Tennant and Clarissa Dickson Wright.

programme.title: Scams & Scandals
programme.desc: BBC News goes undercover to expose legal advisers charging migrants thousands of pounds to fabricate immigration claims. Some migrants are being encouraged to pretend to be gay to claim asylum. They are advised to gather untrue evidence including supporting letters and photos at LGBT events, for their applications. Others are encouraged to make false allegation of domestic abuse. The investigation finds advisers exploiting migrants and abusing safeguards designed to protect those truly at risk.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Noson o amgylch y tân, tan bo un o linynnau gitâr Bych yn torri. Tybed o ble y dawn nhw o hyd i un? A cosy campfite night, but then one of Teensy's guitar strings snaps.

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Deryn Y Si Yn Suo
programme.desc: There was a time when Hummingbird did not hum. She was called Songbird and thought she could sing like a bird, but sadly that was not the case. All the animals tried to help Songbird improve her singing but nothing worked. Then Tortoise had an idea, maybe Songbird could sing without opening her beak.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: Ysgol Llantrisant sy'n ymuno â Ben Dant a Cadi i herio'r byd y tro 'ma. Ysgol Llantrisant joins Ben Dant and Cadi for a little adventure.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Izzy tries to win the county show's vegetable competition with her giant marrow, while Siôn's disaster in the kitchen means there is not enough food for everyone.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Awn yn ol i'r flwyddyn 1804 i ddysgu am y trên stem cyntaf a gafodd ei ddefnyddio yng Nghymru, yn Merthyr Tudful. Going back to 1804 to learn about the very first steam train, located in the town of Merthyr Tydfil in Wales.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Ymweld ag ysgolion ....pynciau ysgafn ... lot o chwerthin!

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Blero'n gweld defaid Ffermwr Ffred yn crwydro o gwmpas Ocido, mae'n casglu nhw ar gyfer cneifo. Blero sees Ffarmwr Ffred's sheep,he rounds them up in time for their annual shearing.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Pwy oedd y person cyntaf ar y lleuad? Cyfle euraidd i Tad-cu ddweud wrtho mai ei fam-gu a'i ffrind Beti oedd y bobl yna! Hari's question today is: who was the first person on the moon?

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, ac mae o wrth ei fodd gyda bocs botymau Dewyrth John. Ond o'i agor, mae'r botymau yn mynd i bobman. Pablo and friends have fun with some buttons!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Ryan yn ffonio Harri o'r ganolfan fowlio deg gan fod y sgitls yn sownd yn y peiriant. Ryan calls Harri from the tenpin bowling centre because the skittles are stuck in the machine.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Bîp Bîp, Pi Po, Bop and Bw are best friends and love to learn new words in Welsh in the form of animations, songs and rhymes, simple games and short items filmed with small children.

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Norman a Hanna yn ymchwilio i ddigwyddiadau lleol dirgel. Norman and Hanna investigate mysterious local goings-on.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamborî! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae Digbi'n gobeithio mai dyma ei flwyddyn i ennill `Y Ras Fawr'! Digbi hopes that this is his year to win `The Great Race', but Glenys tells Teifion that she must win the race.

programme.title: Jen a Jim a'r Cywiadur
programme.desc: Mae Bolgi'n pobi bara, ond yn anffodus, wrth i'r bara oeri, mae rhywun neu rywbeth yn cipio hanner y dorth. Bolgi is a good chef and has just finished baking fresh bread, but unfortunately, as the bread is cooling on the table in the garden, someone or something snatches half the loaf.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Llygaid yw'r thema y tro hwn, gan edrych ar yr afr a'r igwana. Eyes are the theme this time - looking at the goat and the iguana.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.sub-title: Yr Octonots a'r Argyfwng Cnau Coco
programme.desc: Harri and the Octonauts help their old friends the Coconut Crabs to discover who's stealing their coconuts.

programme.title: Sali Mali
programme.desc: Gan fod glaw'n dod i mewn drwy dwll yn y to, rhaid i Sali a'i ffrindiau gyd-weithio i wneud ychydig o waith trwsio. A hole in the roof where the rain comes in means do-it-yourself repairs.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Mae Joni a Jini yn cyfnewid cyrff ar ddamwain! Gyda drwgweithredwyr angen eu dal, maen nhw'n dysgu meistroli eu sgiliau ei gilydd! Joni and Jini accidentally switch bodies!

programme.title: Waw!
programme.desc: Y corff sy'n cael sylw Awi a chriw Waw y tro yma. The body get's the attention of Awi and the crew.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r teulu cyfan ar y to yn gwylio'r sêr. Maen nhw'n adeiladu telesgop, ac yn gweld rhywbeth annisgwyl iawn! The family is on the roof star-gazing and see something highly surprising!

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Gan Hiena Goesau Ol Byr
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hyena didn't have short back legs. He was always chasing around and nipping other animals on the bottom. Then one day the animals had enough. It was time to teach that naughty Hyena a lesson.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: The young pirates from Ysgol Login Fach help Bendant and Cadi raise the Ahoi flag, and find out which tasks Capten Cnec has set for them.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Siôn persuades Mario to try a healthy version of his favourite dish.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach Ni
programme.desc: Ceir Cwl. Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn dysgu am bopeth sy'n ymwneud â cheir, ac ewn i Unol Daleithiau America i ddysgu am Henry Ford. In this episode we'll learn about cars.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion Cymru yn trafod amryw bynciau difyr. Wythnos yma, Lliwiau ydi'r pwnc trafod. This week, colours are the topic of discussion in the schools.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae ieir Ffermwr Ffred wedi dianc, mae'r plu yn gwneud i Llinos Llosgfynydd cosi. Mae angen help Blero. Farmer Ffred's chickens have escaped, their feathers make Llinos Llosgfynydd itch.

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: Ar ôl ymweliad at y barbwr, mae Lewis eisiau gwybod 'Pam bod fy ngwallt yn tyfu?'. After a visit to the barber's, Lewis wants to know why his hair grows? Tadcu has an answer.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd, a heddiw nid yw'n siwr p'un ai i dacluso ei degannau neu chwarae efo nhw. Pablo can't decide whether to play with his toys or put them away!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Cyfres hardd a hilariws yw Help Llaw - un sy'n cofleidio, serennu a dyrchafu Cymry ifanc sydd ag anableddau ac anghenion cyfathrebu.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd

programme.desc: Tro hwn, bydd rhai ryseitiau traddodiadol yn creu traddodiadau newydd yn y gegin. Colleen Ramsey looks at food nostalgia. She creates some new traditions in the kitchen.

programme.title: Heno Aur
programme.desc: Y tro hwn, mae Angharad Mair a Siân Thomas yma i chwerthin a rhyfeddu ar rai o straeon mawr Heno ym 1996, pan roedd Cymru yn le hollol wahanol! Angharad Mair and Siân Thomas are here to laugh and marvel at some of Heno's big stories in 1996.

programme.title: Dylan Ar Daith
programme.desc: Dylan Iorwerth sy'n ymweld â phentre' bychan yn Yr Eidal ar gyfer agor amgueddfa i goffau Benjamin Piercy. Dylan Iorwerth visits a small village in Italy for the opening of a museum to commemorate the work of Benjamin Piercy.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd

programme.title: Prynhawn Da
programme.desc: Cyfres gylchgrawn gydag eitemau am lyfrau, coginio, ffasiwn a chyngor am bopeth o addurno'ch cartref i ffilm da! Magazine series including features on fashion, style, antiques and cookery.

programme.title: Newyddion S4C a'r Tywydd
programme.desc: Newyddion a thywydd. Coverage of a wide range of news topics and weather with expert commentary and analysis by BBC Wales correspondents.

programme.title: Cynefin
programme.desc: Rhyfel a heddwch, diwydiant a diwylliant - y tro hwn, bydd ein cyflwynwyr yn crwydro dref farchnad ddiddorol Yr Wyddgrug. War and peace, industry and culture, this time it's Mold's turn.

programme.title: Blwi
programme.desc: At a picnic, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands, but when Coco keeps taking shortcuts, Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn tywys Leisa ar antur i lan y môr i ddysgu iddi amdan gwymon. Hywel, the magical farmer, takes Leisa on an adventure to the seaside to teach her about seaweed.
